answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold: a new identity starts on a narrow ledge, limited to trades until it has dealt with 12 distinct counterparties. Each payment sits in an escrow vault until both sides confirm, and reputation cannot bridge between identities — overlapping clusters are frozen. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 12,000 trades at $4 each, about $48,000; an honest agent trades widely and clears the bar free, so its earnings stay undiluted.
